        test_file not in ctx.sel.GLOB_SCAN_TESTS

`FILE_ANCHORED_SCAN_TESTS` is an EXEMPTION layered on top of the `GLOB_SCAN_TESTS` scan-set exclusion — not a standalone eligibility roster. `GLOB_SCAN_TESTS` (`scripts/select_step9c_tests.py:611`) has exactly three keys: `tests/test_shared_vm_thread_caps.py`, `tests/test_subprocess_env_explicit.py`, `tests/test_select_step9c_tests.py`. `tests/test_workflow_lint.py` is NOT among them — it is a member of `WORKFLOW_INVARIANT` (`:330`), a different registry with a different purpose (always-run gate pins).
